requirements_summary: SaaS KB RAG: moderate index (2-5M chunks), high QPS (400-1,000), tight latency SLOs (p95 <= 250ms for search+rerank), cost sensitivity (target <$0.01/query), need hosted API for quick POC and unified observability; SSO/SAML and audit logging required; EU residency preferred for some customer segments.
index_size_estimate: ~3,000,000 chunks (~1.2TB vectors at 1536 dim), expected growth 20%/mo
cost_target_per_query: goal <$0.01/query end-to-end (including ANN, rerank compute, and hosted API overhead)
preferred_model_profile: dense 1536-d embeddings (bi-encoder for ANN) + cross-encoder 1-3B re-ranker for top-10
reranking_strategy: bi-encoder ANN for candidate generation (top-50) then cross-encoder rerank top-10; fallbacks to smaller cross-encoder for burst traffic; plan to A/B reranker models during POC.
